title: Parenthesized recursive patterns omit their parent directory
prompt: A recursive glob behaves differently when enclosed in parentheses. For example, picomatch.isMatch('test/utils', 'test(/utils/**)') returns false, while the recursive suffix should allow the directory itself as well as descendants. The optional form 'test?(/utils/**)' should also accept that directory. Fix this inconsistency while preserving strictSlashes, nonterminal patterns, and negated extglob behavior. Add regression coverage and keep the existing suite passing.
